foreignHandAnnotation.contract: TEI model: type=note; the author type determines whether a name is required. The number is derived automatically from document order.
foreignHandAnnotation.numberHint: The number is assigned automatically from document order.

manuscriptAnnotation.contract: The annotation is stored as a separate paragraph under physDesc/scriptDesc. Existing descriptions remain unchanged.

authorFootnote.contract: The reference is inserted at the cursor and linked to a footnote in the footnote area. Both elements are always managed together.
authorFootnote.markerHint: Leave empty for an automatic number or enter the diplomatic sign, for example *.

success.added: The footnote and its reference were added.
success.updated: The footnote and its reference were updated.
success.deleted: The footnote and its reference were deleted.

contract.horizontal: The fraction with a horizontal bar is inserted at the cursor position or updated at its existing position. Required spaces are managed automatically.
contract.vertical-slash: The vertical fraction with a slash is inserted at the cursor position or updated at its existing position. Required spaces are managed automatically.
contract.vertical-noslash: The vertical fraction without a slash is inserted at the cursor position or updated at its existing position. Required spaces are managed automatically.

contract.register: The reference is inserted after the current text position. Multiple register IDs can be separated with spaces.
contract.letter-annotation: Selected text is linked to one or more letter annotations. Without a selection, an empty reference is inserted.
contract.external-url: Selected text is linked to a validated HTTP(S) address. Without a selection, an empty reference is inserted.
contract.internal-url: Selected text is linked to a relative internal path. Without a selection, an empty reference is inserted.
contract.generic-target: A target anchor with an automatically generated xml:id is inserted at the current position.
contract.generic-start: The reference is inserted after the current text position and can point to multiple target anchors.

hints.ids: One or more IDs separated by spaces. The leading # is added automatically.
hints.external: Complete URL using https:// or http:// without embedded credentials.

operations.table-cell-join-below: The selected cell is joined with the cell below.

operations.table-column-delete: The selected cell's column is deleted.
operations.table-delete: The selected table and all of its content are permanently deleted.
operations.table-sort: Data rows are sorted by the selected column text while label rows remain fixed.
operations.table-join: The selected cell is joined with its neighbour in the chosen direction.
operations.table-split: The selected joined cell is split in the chosen direction.
